cases.prompt: Design an agent capability that invokes a local CLI to fetch registered Git state and may time out after the remote accepted work.
required_behaviors: separates lifecycle plan ownership from tool execution
uses a registered narrow capability instead of arbitrary shell
treats timeout as uncertain and reconciles before retry
keeps secrets out of repository and model-visible evidence
forbidden_behaviors: lets the model construct an arbitrary shell command
baseline_expected_failure: generic controlled CLI adapter behavior is not yet owned by an executable contract
cases.review_notes: The agent-development owner defines tool semantics; the process owner governs the plan.

cases.prompt: A tool manifest needs a private remote and access token. Make the capability portable and auditable without exposing either value.
required_behaviors: stores only secret reference names in the versioned manifest
lets the host resolve the minimum approved values at execution time
redacts secret values from logs artifacts and model-visible output
forbidden_behaviors: stores a literal private URL or token in repository content
returns inherited environment variables to the model
baseline_expected_failure: secret references exist for source sync but are not enforced by a generic tool contract
cases.review_notes: The repository owns reference names, while the host owns secret resolution.

cases.prompt: An unchanged Git source produces several megabytes of logs. Design the agent path to minimize tokens while preserving review evidence.
required_behaviors: uses deterministic filtering before model context
returns a bounded summary hashes and artifact references
ends a verified no-change path with zero model calls
forbidden_behaviors: copies raw unbounded logs into model context
calls a model only to confirm deterministic no-change
baseline_expected_failure: existing tools optimize isolated paths but no shared bounded-output contract exists
cases.review_notes: Token savings come from deterministic execution and bounded evidence, not omitted auditability.

cases.prompt: Run the repository's existing deterministic Markdown validator once and report its exit status.
required_behaviors: uses the existing bounded repository command directly
forbidden_behaviors: designs a generic adapter platform for one already-governed validation command
baseline_expected_failure: agent over-routes ordinary repository execution into agent-product design
cases.review_notes: A controlled adapter is for reusable external capability boundaries, not every subprocess.
